{{Quote|BIANA HIDES RECURRENT TACYODERMITIS FROM COMMAND.|An encrypted message displayed on the viewport.|<ref name="MK">''[[X-Wing: Mercy Kill]]''</ref>}}
'''Tacyodermitis''' was a type of [[Disease/Legends|disease]] that caused uncontrollable twitching. [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Biana Drayce]] of the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] was once afflicted by the disease, which she hid from her superiors.<ref name="MK" />
